#!/bin/bash

# Export database connection parameters as environment variables
export DB_HOST="localhost"
export DB_PORT="5432"
export DB_NAME="app_db"
export DB_USER="app_user"
export DB_PASSWORD="secure_password"

time=$(date -u)
log_data="{
  \"timestamp\": \"$time\",
  \"db_host\": \"$DB_HOST\",
  \"db_port\": \"$DB_PORT\",
  \"db_name\": \"$DB_NAME\",
  \"db_user\": \"$DB_USER\",
  \"env\": \"production\"
}"

# Send the data to the logging endpoint
response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://monitor.internal/collect \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$log_data")

  echo "Successfully sent metrics to http://monitor.internal/collect"
else
  echo "Failed to send metrics. HTTP status code: $response"
fi
